censoring-named.name: Censoring named
censoring-named.guidance: The agent response explicitly names censored rows and states how observations incomplete before the cutoff date are excluded.
censoring-named.metDescriptor: Clearly names censoring and states how censored rows are excluded.
censoring-named.notMetDescriptor: Omits censoring handling or misstates how incomplete rows are handled.

asks-what-to-improve.name: Asks what to improve
asks-what-to-improve.guidance: When asked to rebuild/improve without specifics, asks a targeted question about what metric, feature, or segment to improve.
asks-what-to-improve.metDescriptor: Asks the user what specific aspect of the model or plan to improve.
asks-what-to-improve.notMetDescriptor: Does not ask what to improve or asks an unrelated question.

failure-reported.name: Failure reported
failure-reported.guidance: When a build fails or is refused by the gate/validation, clearly reports the failure and its recorded reason.
failure-reported.metDescriptor: Explicitly reports the build/gate failure and plain reason.
failure-reported.notMetDescriptor: Hides the failure or claims success despite refusal/failure.
